# Fort Worth Botanic Garden - Digital

> Home for a growing collection of digital tools and resources from the Fort Worth Botanic
> Garden (FWBG), including datasets, dashboards, and applications.

This file expands on llms.txt with the full detail an LLM needs to understand what this site
is, what each part contains, and — critically — where each part actually comes from, since most
of the site is generated elsewhere and republished here.

## Site overview

fwbg.github.io aggregates digital resources from the Fort Worth Botanic Garden and the
Botanical Research Institute of Texas (BRIT). It is fed by three distinct mechanisms:

1. **Manual direct commits** to this repo's `main` branch — used for the site's own scaffolding
   (`index.html`, `.nojekyll`, `README.md`, `PUBLISHING.md`). Nothing
   generates or syncs these files automatically.
2. **Automated publish of `/begonias/`** from a GitHub Actions workflow in
   [FWBG/living_collections](https://github.com/FWBG/living_collections)
   (`.github/workflows/publish-begonia.yml`). It stages the Begonia dashboard with
   `tools/stage-pages.py` and rsyncs it (`--delete`) into this repo's `begonias/` folder using a
   PAT secret, committing as `fwbg-pages-bot <actions@github.com>`.
3. **Automated publish of `/collections/`** from a separate source repo,
   [FWBG/collections](https://github.com/FWBG/collections), using the same bot-publish pattern.

Full detail on the publishing pipelines is in [PUBLISHING.md](https://fwbg.github.io/PUBLISHING.md).

**Implication for anyone editing this site or its sources:** `begonias/` and `collections/` are
CI-generated mirrors. Edits made directly inside those folders on `fwbg.github.io` will be
silently overwritten the next time the corresponding workflow runs. The real, editable source
for the Begonia dashboard lives in `FWBG/living_collections` (dashboard files under
`dashboards/begonia/`, `fwbg/`); the source for the collections index lives in `FWBG/collections`.

## Pages

### Home — `/index.html`

Landing page for the site. States the site's purpose (digital tools and resources: datasets,
dashboards, applications) and links out to the two GitHub organizations behind the content:
[FWBG](https://github.com/FWBG) and [BRIT](https://github.com/BRITorg/). Manually maintained —
not generated.

### Begonia Collection dashboard — `/begonias/`

Interactive dashboard for exploring the Begonia collection: charts (`src/charts-fwbg.jsx`), a
sortable/filterable data table (`src/table-fwbg.jsx`), and a tweaks panel for adjusting the view
(`tweaks-panel.jsx`), built as a client-rendered React app (React 18 + Babel standalone loaded
from CDN, no build step) reading data from `data/collections-v2.js`.

- **Source of truth:** [FWBG/living_collections](https://github.com/FWBG/living_collections)
- **Published by:** `.github/workflows/publish-begonia.yml`, triggered on pushes to
  `dashboards/begonia/**`, `fwbg/**`, or `tools/stage-pages.py`, or manual dispatch.
- **Commit signature on this repo:** `Publish begonia dashboard from FWBG/living_collections@<sha>`

### FWBG Collections — `/collections/`

Index page describing the many collections and their digital counterparts at FWBG and BRIT, with
links out to each, alongside its own `index.html` and `styles.css`.

- **Source of truth:** [FWBG/collections](https://github.com/FWBG/collections) (not mirrored
  locally in this workspace as of 2026-09-22; inferred from commit pattern)
- **Commit signature on this repo:** `Publish collections page from FWBG/collections@<sha>`
- This has been the most active of the two automated pipelines to date.

## External collection portals — crawling guidance

The FWBG Collections page (`/collections/`) links out to several third-party collection-management
systems. Some of these expose structured bulk-data endpoints that are far cheaper to fetch than
crawling their search/browse pages one record at a time — use these where available. Checked
2026-09-22.

### Symbiota herbarium portals (torcherbaria.org / SEINet / SERNEC network)

FWBG/BRIT specimen data is hosted on Symbiota-based portals, linked from `/collections/` as
`collprofiles.php?collid=<ID>` pages:

| Collection | Profile page | DwC-A download | GBIF dataset |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| BRIT Herbarium | `.../collprofiles.php?collid=370` | https://portal.torcherbaria.org/portal/content/dwca/BRIT-BRIT_DwC-A.zip | https://www.gbif.org/dataset/defb9a47-c1a7-4fb2-9a0b-2da7c5260cad |
| Vanderbilt University Herbarium (BRIT-VDB) | `.../collprofiles.php?collid=264` | https://sernecportal.org/portal/content/dwca/BRIT-VDB_DwC-A.zip | https://www.gbif.org/dataset/3111dc38-3143-4792-9802-610f1de4961c |
| Univ. of Houston Coastal Center Herbarium (UHCC) | `.../collprofiles.php?collid=509` | https://portal.torcherbaria.org/portal/content/dwca/UHCC_DwC-A.zip | (linked from profile page) |

Each collection profile page links directly to a **Darwin Core Archive (DwC-A)** zip — a complete,
structured snapshot of every specimen record — plus a GBIF dataset page. EML metadata for any
collection on this network is also available at the stable, collid-parametrized path
`datasets/emlhandler.php?collid=<ID>` relative to the portal root.

**General rule:** for any link matching `*/collections/misc/collprofiles.php?collid=*` (a Symbiota
collection profile, on this or any other SEINet/SERNEC-network portal), fetch the DwC-A/GBIF/EML
links on that profile page instead of crawling the occurrence-search interface — this pattern holds
for any future Symbiota-hosted collection linked from this site, not just the three above.

### UNT Portal to Texas History (texashistory.unt.edu)

Collections linked from `/collections/` (e.g. `/explore/collections/SJCC/`) expose a JSON API per
collection at `/explore/collections/<CODE>/api/` and an RSS feed at `/explore/collections/<CODE>/feed/`.
Prefer the API for structured metadata over paging through browse/search results.

### FWBG Garden Explorer (fwbg.gardenexplorer.org)

Live-plant-records system (IrisBG, by Compositae AS). No public bulk export or API was found on the
public interface as of 2026-09-22 — treat as browse-only and avoid exhaustive crawling; a targeted
name/genus search is the practical option here.

### TCU Primo catalog, txarchives.org (TARO), CBHL LibGuides

Not verified for bulk-access endpoints — the txarchives.org fetch was blocked by an access-control
check during this check, and the others weren't checked. Treat as ordinary browse targets unless
confirmed otherwise; don't assume an API exists.

## Source repositories

| Repo | Role |
| --- | --- |
| [FWBG/FWBG.github.io](https://github.com/FWBG/FWBG.github.io) | This site — the publish target for all three mechanisms above |
| [FWBG/living_collections](https://github.com/FWBG/living_collections) | Editable source of the Begonia dashboard, published into `/begonias/` |
| [FWBG/collections](https://github.com/FWBG/collections) | Editable source of the collections index, published into `/collections/` |
| [FWBG on GitHub](https://github.com/FWBG) | Full list of Fort Worth Botanic Garden repositories |
| [BRIT on GitHub](https://github.com/BRITorg/) | Full list of Botanical Research Institute of Texas repositories |

## Notes for LLM agents

- If asked to change something visible on fwbg.github.io, first check whether the path is under
  `/begonias/` or `/collections/` — if so, the change belongs in the source repo
  (`living_collections` or `collections`), not here.
- `index.html` is the only part of this repo safe to edit directly.
- This site aggregates content across repositories; it does not itself contain the underlying
  botanical/collections datasets — those live in the source repos linked above.
